title: On Starting the work before the light came
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：start　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 start 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the cook ① started the work before the light came in the rain, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② starts the work before the light came without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ start the work before the light came at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ started the work before the light came before — a line in the menu for September 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Starting the work before the light came in the rain, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ start for the coast at first light without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Start for the coast at first light at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ starts for the coast at first light in the rain every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ started the work before the light came again when nobody else would.

⑩ To start the work before the light came, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody starts the work before the light came without complaint again and somebody must start the work before the light came in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 开始（一般过去式 started the work before the light came：1968 年厨子头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 开始（一般现在 starts the work before the light came：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 开始（不定式 to start the work before the light came：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 开始（过去完成时 had started the work before the light came：1962 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 开始（动名词 starting the work before the light came 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 动身（start for the coast at first light：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去动身天一亮就往海边去）
G. v. 动身（start for the coast at first light：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 开始（后段两处：新来的客人照例 starts for the coast at first light，而母亲又一次 started the work before the light came）

answers.why: start 意为“开始”，1968 年厨子淋着雨开始天没亮就动工，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 started。
start 意为“开始”，自那以后厨子毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 starts。
start 意为“开始”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯开始天没亮就动工”，此处为不定式 to start the work before the light came。
start 意为“开始”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人开始过，故用过去完成时 had started。
start 意为“开始”，厨子说“开始天没亮就动工这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 starting the work before the light came 作主语。
start 意为“动身”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去动身天一亮就往海边去”，should ever 之后用原形 start for the coast at first light。
start 意为“动身”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻动身天一亮就往海边去（start for the coast at first light at once），以后再也不要提起。
start 意为“开始”，新来的客人每个日子都照例动身天一亮就往海边去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 starts。
start 意为“开始”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨开始天没亮就动工，用一般过去式 started 叙述。
start 意为“开始”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要开始天没亮就动工，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，厨子淋着雨开始天没亮就动工；食堂里每一个客人都说这是头一回。（started the work before the light came）
多年以后，厨子仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（starts the work before the light came）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯开始天没亮就动工这件事本身。（to start the work before the light came）
早在 1962 年就有人开始天没亮就动工，九月那天菜单上的一行字就是证据。（had started the work before the light came）
厨子说过，淋着雨开始天没亮就动工这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（starting the work before the light came 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻动身天一亮就往海边去，以后再也不要提起。（start for the coast at first light，祈使句）
answers: In 1968 the cook started the work before the light came in the rain, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the cook still starts the work before the light came without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to start the work before the light came at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had started the work before the light came long before 1975, and the line in the menu for September proves it.
Starting the work before the light came in the rain, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Start for the coast at first light at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 start 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the cook started the work before the light came in the rain, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook starts the work before the light came without complaint whenever the canteen asks.
Starting the work before the light came in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever start for the coast at first light without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen starts for the coast at first light in the rain every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother started the work before the light came again, and the canteen remembered that half.
